findings.title: Total debugging speedup does not follow from the debugger-only speedup
findings.location: Table 1 p. 4; Section 3.2.3 Eq. 11 p. 6; total costs Eqs. 7 and 10 p. 5
findings.suspect: The optimized QA scan can dominate focused total cost even when debugging dominates naive total cost.
assumptions_preserved: At most one bug per function
counterevidence: Individual QA Theta(b^2) and debugger Theta(b*k^2) ratios are valid
Prose qualifies expected debugger dominance as likely
No empirical industrial-code experiment is refuted
findings.core_dependency: One of three core example separations; the incorrect total scaling is used to motivate large-codebase benefits. Easy repair and surviving agenda do not remove this dependency.
findings.supported_impact: General displayed total improvement must be replaced or restricted; no evidence that all decomposition benefits vanish.
findings.repair: Keep general ratio, or add sufficient regime md*b*l=Omega(mq*k) with b<=k,l>=1; state joint asymptotic growth.
findings.version_status: Improvement appears in arXiv v1 p. 5 and v2/original pp. 4/6; no correction identified in inspected sources.

findings.title: Printed local-mutation loop can remain in a closed nonterminal state
findings.location: Table 1 p. 4; arbitrary initial solution in Section 3.3.1 p. 6; Eqs. 13-14 pp. 6-7
findings.claim: Expected local cost Theta(mu*k*l^2), yielding Theta(2^k*k) improvement
findings.suspect: Index advances only after strict improvement; an already-correct block cannot improve while later incorrect blocks remain.

check.kernel_properties: Selected tokens always change; each output correct with probability 1/2; independent across blocks/calls
check.local_proposals: (B,a) fitness 1, (a,a) fitness 0; both rejected; state unchanged
check.asymptotic_family: All k>=2, l=1, x=(A,a,...,a), i=0: same local stall; global conditional success 2^-k per attempt and expectation 2^k

assumptions_preserved: Independent fair mutation, a stronger intended assumption
counterevidence: A corrected local method can achieve the intended worst-case order
All-incorrect initialization also repairs the specific stall if justified
v1 omits Table 1, so its absent pseudocode is not alleged to contain the printed-loop defect
findings.core_dependency: The finite-cost local guarantee and exponential separation are a central motivating analytical example. The supplied implementation violates its guarantee on an asymptotic family.
findings.supported_impact: Printed algorithm has no finite expected local bound on all permitted inputs; broad value of local search is not refuted.
findings.repair: Skip correct blocks using an explicit available correctness test and account for its cost, or justify all-incorrect initialization. With r initially incorrect blocks, a corrected method uses 2r expected mutation calls; Theta(mu*r*l^2), worst-case Theta(mu*k*l^2).
findings.additional_scope: Global 2^k assumes nonoptimum and suitable independence; k*2^k is exponential times polynomial, not super-exponential. Terminology is not counted separately.
findings.version_status: v2 and publisher Table 1 retain index inside strict-improvement branch; arbitrary initialization exists in v1/v2.

inspection_outcomes.result: Theta(k*n/(k+n)) for mg=md=k,ms=1; Theta(k) needs suitable n regime. Prose supports charitable large-n reading.
Loss-vs-size/data/compute laws do not establish mg=Theta(k*ms); paper already frames linear relation as assumption.
32,768 router weights per layer; 1,048,576 across 32 layers. Experts are feedforward blocks; routing remains qualitatively inexpensive.
Assigned m[nt+t(t-1)/2] differs from separate input/output-token billing; no refutation of conditional mn calculations.
Preserve explicit Sections 5.1-5.6 scope; do not invent extra experimental failure findings.
